====Additional specifications==== :per the manufacturer's site, follow... *Noted as being tri-band, supporting 2.4 GHz (2402 ~ 2482 MHz), :PSB (4940 ~ 4990 MHz), and 5 GHz (5180 ~ 5825 MHz) bands *Receive sensitivity: ranges from -100 to -62 dBm, +- 2 dBm **Receiver LNA gain: +10 dBm **'high selectivity band-pass filters' are noted as being used *Tx power: up to 22 dBm per stream w/ QAM16 (MCS4), :27 dBm aggregate for 3 streams *Ambient operating temp. range: 0°C to +80°C *Dimensions: noted as [[Dimensions::30 mm x 50 mm x 6 mm]] *<small>additionally, ''loopback'' mode is supported to assist FIPS [[wikipedia:Advanced Encryption Standard|AES]] certification</small> and :<small>integrated GPS ('''SiRF Star IV''', includes power feed for an active antenna) or :USB hub capability is also (optionally) available</small>
